messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — LumenForge just went GA on GCP Marketplace with a Redwood-integrated offering! :tada: They shipped a Dedicated + Private deploy option and opted into the co-sell program. Listing: https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/details/lumenforge/redwood-lumenforge

jordan: Amazing — any perf snapshots we can share in the case study?

maria: Yup — benching on a 4xA100 Dedicated pool: p95 down ~35%, sustained throughput ~3x vs their previous setup. Cost/unit looked better with our batching + KV cache recommendations.

priya: Love it. I'll loop in field marketing. @ava will you want a customer quote and a short winsheet?

ava: On it. Ben, can you grab a concise quote from the LumenForge PM for the one-pager?

ben: Got one from Leo (LumenForge PM): "Moving to Redwood gave us predictable latency and cut our infra spend — we finally stopped guessing capacity." I'll paste a polished quote to the drive.

priya: Perfect. I'll schedule a co-sell intro with the GCP partner team tomorrow. Need a quick bullets doc — @jordan any objections to me using the perf numbers above?

jordan: No objections. Maybe add the config we used: `dedicated.pool=4xA100, batching=auto, kv_cache=enabled` so field teams have something reproducible.

maria: Deploy-bot just posted the marketplace link public listing: https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/product/lumenforge/redwood-lumenforge-deploy (public). :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: listing published by ci/cd (pipeline #8247) — visibility: public; status: GA.

ava: Drafting one-pager now. Will ping for review in #marketing in ~30m. Can someone drop a quick screenshot of the dashboard (latency graph + cost savings)?

ben: Dropping the screenshot link in the drive momentarily. Also attaching short customer blurb: "Redwood's runtime allowed us to cut tail latency and confidently commit to a reserved pool — game changer for our revenue-critical workflows."

priya: Incredible work team — huge win for partnerships & field motion. :rocket: Will update CRM and tag this as "Marketplace GA + Co-sell"

maria: Thanks everyone — shoutout to eng/solutions for the late push to support their private mode. Celebratory donuts on me next week for SF office :)

jordan: I'll share the deployment recipe in the solutions repo after the one-pager is live.

ava: Marking this as customer-case: lumenforge-gcp in our assets tracker.

maria: Closing thread, will follow up with the published case study link when ready.
